ecus.name: HV battery management (BMS)
ecus.notes: Cell voltages, SOH, energy counters. On ID.3 the BMS may be reachable directly or via gateway; verified during discovery.

ecus.name: Central gateway (J533)
ecus.notes: Serves the Car Scanner '[19.Gate]' measurements. Addressing 0x710 (request) -> 0x77A (response) is CONFIRMED by a passive Bluetooth HCI capture of Car Scanner on 2026-10-15: ATSH710 / ATFCSH710 / ATCRA77A on ATSP6 with flow control ATFCSD300000 + ATFCSM1. The earlier 0x792->0x710 pair and the '+0x6A encoding' reading were wrong: 0x77A really is the response id. See docs/investigation/meb_gateway_energy_passive_capture_20261015.md.

ecus.name: HV charge management
ecus.notes: SOC normal, charge mode, CCS status, remaining time.

ecus.name: Motor electronics
ecus.notes: Also answers standard OBD-II modes 01/09 on MEB cars.

ecus.name: Gateway energy information
ecus.notes: MEB module 0x710: HV energy content (SoH source). NOTE: unlike the BMS/DC-DC/vehicle-info modules this one is NOT on the 29-bit bus -- it is addressed 11-bit with ATCP 00 + ATSH 000710 and answers at 0x77A.

ecus.name: Climate control
ecus.notes: MEB module 0x746: cabin and ambient temperature. Also 11-bit addressed (ATCP 00 + ATSH 000746 -> 0x7B0).

ecus.name: Vehicle info (odometer/gear/VIN)
ecus.notes: MEB module 0x76: odometer, gear position, VIN.

ecus.name: Electric drive (motor/inverter)
ecus.notes: MEB module 0x7C: torque, motor speed, inverter losses, DC link, rotor/stator temperatures. 29-bit addressed (0x17FC007C -> 0x17FE007C).

ecus.name: GPS / telematics
ecus.notes: MEB module 0x767: satellite counts. 11-bit addressed (ATCP 00 + ATSH 000767 -> 0x7D1).
